reviews.review:
It’s been about 8 years since I have dined at Bistro Moncur and it’s exactly as I remember it. Classic French food, attentive service in a large dining space.
Never disappoints, the food is always on point and reliable.
Had the chicken liver, classic.
Steak and fries with Bearnaise sauce.
Leafy salad and
Raspberry soufflé.
Food was too good and forgot to take photos of the entree and 🍰.
Won’t wait so long to go back again.

Had such a lovely birthday dinner here last night. The service was genuinely outstanding and consistent from the phone to actual dining experience - respectful, kind, thoughtful and never once judgmental. The space was comfortable, spacious and beautiful.
Thank you!
We've been visiting for many years and it never disappoints. Excellent food, service and wine. We'll keep coming back.
We had a date night here and as always, the food was impeccable. We loved our steaks and the oysters were very fresh. The service from the staff was attentive and will be back.

French cuisine at its best, without the 24 hour flight to France! Rich, large portions that will leave your belly full if you order an entree, mains and dessert. Every dish we choose was so different and delicious - full of creamy butter and French flair.

Loved the French onion soufflé gratin - possibly the best onion dish I’ve ever had. The soufflé was a delight, light and fluffy, and a bit of entertainment as it wobbles on a sea of cheese sauce. Wow!

We were so impressed by the chicken liver pate. A generous serving well paired with brioche toast and sweet quince jam. Our other friend had the beef tartare and loved every bite as well.

Mains were well portioned. I had the barramundi and it was cooked perfectly. Extra crispy skin and soft fleshy fish. Would have loved a few more vongole.

The best part was dessert - the waitress was so kind to ask the kitchen if they could serve the chocolate soufflé even though it has been off the menu for months. Thank you for the show and it was such a treat. Dark chocolate, rich and fluffy all at the same time. Us chocolate lovers were in heaven.

I was pleasantly surprised by the Black Forest Bombe Alaska. I’ve had a few Bombe Alaskas in my life but this one had a well balanced taste in every bite - like a delicious Weiss bar but better. Would’ve loved it if it came out lit and on fire at the table - within fire, OH&S regulations of course.

So glad to finally dine here and will be back. Thank you also for accommodating an unexpected guest last minute. Fantastic customer service (and beautiful ceiling).

I have always been aware of this place but have never been. Wow, what have I been missing for so long? From the moment we walked into the restaurant, we were greeted by the most welcoming gentleman who attended to us and sorted out or booking, took us to our seats and ensured we were attended to with drinks and menus. The staff could not have been more helpful. They were very well aware of the menu items and could answer any questions relating to the various dishes in a truly professional manner.The selection of dishes is not extensive; however, each dish presented made picking "The One" difficult as everything was so tempting. The onion souffle is something dreams are made of, full of flavor and such a wonderful marriage of taste and texture I wanted more. The pork cutlet was well presented and again, taste and texture were perfect a well-thought-out combination of strong bursts of quality ingredients salty anchovies and sharp capers really excited the pallet with every mouth full.Moving on to the desserts, this sent me into a space where only the immortals should venture. The passionfruit souffle was like nothing I have tried before and a real complement to the Chef. However, the truly standout experience was the apple tart with ginger ice cream. Eating this sent my Epicurean radar into overdrive. I am confident that whoever exhibited this masterpiece will be rewarded in the restaurant of heaven. This will be my new favourite place to eat. All the staff were so nice to deal with and nothing was a trouble. Well done to all.

We enjoyed a delicious evening meal at Bistro Moncur on Tuesday evening with Paddington friends (who were semi -regulars). Welcomed on our slightly early arrival and given a choice of outside tables. Good for conversation, though main room noise level is pretty good as well. The Barramundi fish was described as delicious and the 3 steaks were tender and cooked as requested. Leaf salad and broccoli were excellent additions. No extra chips were needed! Note the chocolate mouse was definitely generous and 2 of us shared it.
We had driven from Cammeray so were careful about timing in rush hour, but we arrived in good time and found an unlimited parking spot just by the side of the Bistro.
Toilets (in case anyone is interested) were clean, well stocked with paper towels and nice washing soap).
The service prior to our meal and when taking our orders and during the meal was faultless. The waitress was smiling and informative.
Thank you Bistro Mosman management & staff for a lovely evening.

The food was well portioned and delicious! Highlight dishes were the steak with Paris butter and fries, chicken pate and pear Mille feuille! The best part of the night was our server Jackson was so attentive and went above and beyond - making the birthday dinner very special!  Will definitely be back here!! Loved it!

Sydney Extra 24 Hour Restaurant is a great spot right in front of Circular Quay, and it’s perfect when you’re looking for good food at any time of the day or night. The food is surprisingly very good for a 24-hour place — fresh, tasty, and with generous portions. They also have a nice selection of drinks, and enjoying a cold beer here after a late-night walk is always a bonus.

The location is unbeatable. Being right by Circular Quay makes it incredibly convenient, especially when everything else is closed. More than once, after walking around the Opera House or enjoying the harbour views late at night, this place has saved the night with a good meal and a relaxed atmosphere.

The staff are friendly, the service is quick, and the place feels welcoming no matter the hour. If you’re in the area, whether it’s for a midnight snack or a casual meal with a great view, this restaurant is a reliable and enjoyable choice. Highly recommended!

Perfect place to grab food after a City Walk. Located Perfectly right infront of the Wharf 4.
Tbh I wasn’t expecting much from this cafe but the moment i saw Yubraj (staff) smile and welcome us we knew this is going to be a good Saturday morning.
We ordered the Big breakfast and the rum hot chocolate. The Hot chocolate Rum was an interesting find.. Perfect when you want to indulge but keep it in check🤭 at 8 in the morning.
As for the service I kid you not we forgot for a bit we were in Sydney 🫣 jokes apart a welcoming smile, friendly joke and a genuine hospitality is all that we love after a long work week and this was what we experienced here.
I will return again for the friendly smiles.

​If it’s 2:00 a.m. and you’re looking for a place to sit down and eat that isn't the front seat of your car in a Macca’s car park, City Extra is one of the few options left. On that front, it serves a purpose. It’s a reliable, late-night landmark with a view, and the staff are actually quite friendly and welcoming, which is a plus at that hour.
City Extra relies heavily on nostalgia. It was the "place to be" back in the day when Sydney’s late-night dining options were slim. But nostalgia doesn't justify the bill. The food and drinks are significantly overpriced for what you actually get on the plate. While the iced chocolate was nice and hit the spot, it doesn't make up for the fact that the overall food quality simply doesn't match the price point.
City Extra feels stuck in the past—except for its pricing, which is very much in the present. If you’re there for the memories or the 2 a.m. convenience, you’ll be fine. But if you’re looking for value for money or high-quality fare? Meh.

The food was really good. Portions were great and presentation was on point. The gentlemen who took our order was extremely kind. It isn't necessarily cheap, but considering the quality and location we were satisfied. Would definitely come back. Chicken Parm pictured below

Had brunch here in our recent holiday in Sydney. Serving sizes were huge. Happily offered gluten free option to our meals. Team were friendly and was so prompt to take our orders and deliver our meals. If ever back in Sydney would go there again for sure.

I visited recently after loving this place on a visit from overseas 9 years ago — it was just as good as I remembered! The server was prompt and very friendly, and our lattes were yummy. We both ordered fish and chips, which were delicious, served with a delicate breading, a tasty salad and wonderful thick chips/fries. Scones — our favorite from our visits years ago — made a scrumptious dessert, which were fabulous with clotted cream and jam. We got some for takeaway, and they were just as good for breakfast the next morning.

There are great seating options: inside at booths and tables, upstairs with views out over the harbor, and outdoors in front. All were popular.

Now I just have to make the 16-hour flight again before another 9 years!

My girlfriend and I went to this venue during Vivid 2026 and they still continued to have great service. The food was great, it came out quickly. Would definitely recommend this place

This was recommended to us by locals and turned out to be a superb choice.
The menu is a a pan-Asian mix of Thai favourites and other dishes from across Southeast Asia, with some Mexican bits thrown in.
But it works. The food is superb. Tasty, well presented, and at a good price for the quality.
There’s a good range of beers and wines on the menu, and staff were great. They were excellent at dealing with a request for gluten free for one person.
A fantastic choose if you’re visiting Coogee.

Lovely meal at Sugarcane. Hadn’t eaten here for a few years and a few old favourites were still in the menu. Standout was the crispy cauliflower, amazing. I also had the hot & sour salad which is served Sam choy beau style this was good but quite spicy. Children’s blood plum rice meals were good and worth trying for adults :). Slight let down was the beef rendang which felt like it was missing some of its indo flavours, slightly gravy ish flavours. Staff were lovely to deal with and I’ll defo come back to try some of the specials.

A friend recommended we try the Trust Me menu after Bondi Coogee beach walk.  So we trusted her and tried it and We loved it!!!  Everything was delicious.  Loved the starters bc they were so refreshing after the walk.  We had the prawn cakes, king fish sashimi, and the salmon ceviche lettuce cups.  Yum yum!
Really tasty food. Roti incredible and all the sauces as well. Chicken some of the best I’ve had. Pricy but worth the price point.
The food is alright a bit taking too long….. we’ve waited for about 30 mins for the main dishes…. A bit pricey too… the services are excellent tho!

We enjoyed our meal very much, we had the Trust me menu, we were ever impressed by the choice given to us. The atmosphere was buzzing and everyone looked as if they were enjoying theirs too. Service was 2nd to none and very efficient.

Group of 8 dining on a busy Saturday night. Was seated at a long table with stools. Not extremely comfortable but depends on how long you stay.
Service was quick , attentive. Food arrived quickly with all dishes on banquet arriving within 30mins.

The $70 pp banquet is adequate but pricey for what you receive. I feel the experience would be better if you were able to choose your entrees and mains to share.

The service charge is high so beware when dining in large groups

Food. The crab and green apple entree was way to much apple. Not balanced.

Salmon entree was great.

Mains were fine, chicken and a vegetable curry were tasty

Great Dining Experience at Sugarcane. had a fantastic meal in here, I cannot choose which are my favorite because they're all so so good! The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented.

reviews.review:
Sydney Extra 24 Hour Restaurant is a great spot right in front of Circular Quay, and it’s perfect when you’re looking for good food at any time of the day or night. The food is surprisingly very good for a 24-hour place — fresh, tasty, and with generous portions. They also have a nice selection of drinks, and enjoying a cold beer here after a late-night walk is always a bonus.

The location is unbeatable. Being right by Circular Quay makes it incredibly convenient, especially when everything else is closed. More than once, after walking around the Opera House or enjoying the harbour views late at night, this place has saved the night with a good meal and a relaxed atmosphere.

The staff are friendly, the service is quick, and the place feels welcoming no matter the hour. If you’re in the area, whether it’s for a midnight snack or a casual meal with a great view, this restaurant is a reliable and enjoyable choice. Highly recommended!

Perfect place to grab food after a City Walk. Located Perfectly right infront of the Wharf 4.
Tbh I wasn’t expecting much from this cafe but the moment i saw Yubraj (staff) smile and welcome us we knew this is going to be a good Saturday morning.
We ordered the Big breakfast and the rum hot chocolate. The Hot chocolate Rum was an interesting find.. Perfect when you want to indulge but keep it in check🤭 at 8 in the morning.
As for the service I kid you not we forgot for a bit we were in Sydney 🫣 jokes apart a welcoming smile, friendly joke and a genuine hospitality is all that we love after a long work week and this was what we experienced here.
I will return again for the friendly smiles.

​If it’s 2:00 a.m. and you’re looking for a place to sit down and eat that isn't the front seat of your car in a Macca’s car park, City Extra is one of the few options left. On that front, it serves a purpose. It’s a reliable, late-night landmark with a view, and the staff are actually quite friendly and welcoming, which is a plus at that hour.
City Extra relies heavily on nostalgia. It was the "place to be" back in the day when Sydney’s late-night dining options were slim. But nostalgia doesn't justify the bill. The food and drinks are significantly overpriced for what you actually get on the plate. While the iced chocolate was nice and hit the spot, it doesn't make up for the fact that the overall food quality simply doesn't match the price point.
City Extra feels stuck in the past—except for its pricing, which is very much in the present. If you’re there for the memories or the 2 a.m. convenience, you’ll be fine. But if you’re looking for value for money or high-quality fare? Meh.

The food was really good. Portions were great and presentation was on point. The gentlemen who took our order was extremely kind. It isn't necessarily cheap, but considering the quality and location we were satisfied. Would definitely come back. Chicken Parm pictured below

Had brunch here in our recent holiday in Sydney. Serving sizes were huge. Happily offered gluten free option to our meals. Team were friendly and was so prompt to take our orders and deliver our meals. If ever back in Sydney would go there again for sure.

I visited recently after loving this place on a visit from overseas 9 years ago — it was just as good as I remembered! The server was prompt and very friendly, and our lattes were yummy. We both ordered fish and chips, which were delicious, served with a delicate breading, a tasty salad and wonderful thick chips/fries. Scones — our favorite from our visits years ago — made a scrumptious dessert, which were fabulous with clotted cream and jam. We got some for takeaway, and they were just as good for breakfast the next morning.

There are great seating options: inside at booths and tables, upstairs with views out over the harbor, and outdoors in front. All were popular.

Now I just have to make the 16-hour flight again before another 9 years!

Dec 25th Christmas Day 2025
Good for a quick lunch/munch stop when visiting the Sydney Opera House
Quick service, friendly staff, clean and kid friendly
My girlfriend and I went to this venue during Vivid 2026 and they still continued to have great service. The food was great, it came out quickly. Would definitely recommend this place

I've been there years ago and was pleasantly surprised that it is still so very good. Service was pleasant even though after multiple attempts, the waiter still couldn't get the table from wobbling. If you sit in a booth, it can get really hot, and somehow, the noise just really centres there.
Having said that, the food is divine. Whatever they are doing to that lamb, OMG keep doing it. And the dessert was to die for. Had the set menu (the pricier one), and it was well worth it. Only disappointment was our replacement choice for one of the dishes due to allergies. It didn't go with the whole flow, but that was not as designed.
I would and have definitely recommended it.
Had lunch here and the food taste and presentation was wonderful. The flavours were very distinct and when we sliced open the lamb, the aroma dazzled my nose. Will definitely come again.

The entry to INDU is a bit hidden and dauntingly down a dimly lit corridor but once you’re inside the restaurant has a great atmosphere and nice lighting. The staff are professional and knows the menu well. Our waitress gave us good suggestions and could clearly articulate what to expect from each dish. The flavours were delicious. We enjoyed every one of them. Love the cocktails and I appreciate that they had a selection of mocktails when you want to slow down. I’d come back again.

Food is good, service was very slow. We came for a work lunch and it took over 2.5hrs to serve us the banquet! We asked the staff to bring the mains quicker but it didn't seem to make a difference to the speed of service. The restaurant was less than half full too.

This hidden place is a basement restaurant, my first SriLankan cuisine experience. The food quality was very good. I tried 3 types of Dosa and all were good, my favorite is the potato dosa.
Mani course we tried the lamb, the chicken and the cabbage. All were good however my favorite was the chicken.
We tried the date putting and the soft serve, both were good. The date pudding was outstanding.

High quality delicious food with a wide variety of flavours. We had the classic feast for 3 people and there was so much amazing food. My favourite was the tuna croquettes and the beef hoppers. The atmosphere is also really great, enough lighting on the food but not on anyone's faces, we really enjoyed sitting in the booths.

Love the venue! Underground with gorgeous huge bowls of spices sending inviting aromas into the room as you enter. The atmosphere was good, not too loud. We were in a comfy booth for 4 people. Cosy but not too small. We all had a cocktail to start which were unique and tasty.
The food was delicious and reasonably priced. We didn’t go for the banquet as we thought it would be too much food. We were very happy with our choices. The only negative was a bottle of wine the lovely friendly waiter suggested, at the end of the night was terrible. Must have been a cheap one marked up to an expensive price. I expect he thought we wouldn’t notice as we had a few drinks by then. Overall I highly recommend Indu and I hope we go back again!

Indu Dining offers a good range of Sri Lankan dishes, though different from the street food I expected. The drink selection is excellent, especially the gin mocktails. We enjoyed the cozy booth seating and the casual vibe. Portions are moderate but satisfying.  Service was fast and friendly.

Sydney Extra 24 Hour Restaurant is a great spot right in front of Circular Quay, and it’s perfect when you’re looking for good food at any time of the day or night. The food is surprisingly very good for a 24-hour place — fresh, tasty, and with generous portions. They also have a nice selection of drinks, and enjoying a cold beer here after a late-night walk is always a bonus.

The location is unbeatable. Being right by Circular Quay makes it incredibly convenient, especially when everything else is closed. More than once, after walking around the Opera House or enjoying the harbour views late at night, this place has saved the night with a good meal and a relaxed atmosphere.

The staff are friendly, the service is quick, and the place feels welcoming no matter the hour. If you’re in the area, whether it’s for a midnight snack or a casual meal with a great view, this restaurant is a reliable and enjoyable choice. Highly recommended!

Perfect place to grab food after a City Walk. Located Perfectly right infront of the Wharf 4.
Tbh I wasn’t expecting much from this cafe but the moment i saw Yubraj (staff) smile and welcome us we knew this is going to be a good Saturday morning.
We ordered the Big breakfast and the rum hot chocolate. The Hot chocolate Rum was an interesting find.. Perfect when you want to indulge but keep it in check🤭 at 8 in the morning.
As for the service I kid you not we forgot for a bit we were in Sydney 🫣 jokes apart a welcoming smile, friendly joke and a genuine hospitality is all that we love after a long work week and this was what we experienced here.
I will return again for the friendly smiles.

​If it’s 2:00 a.m. and you’re looking for a place to sit down and eat that isn't the front seat of your car in a Macca’s car park, City Extra is one of the few options left. On that front, it serves a purpose. It’s a reliable, late-night landmark with a view, and the staff are actually quite friendly and welcoming, which is a plus at that hour.
City Extra relies heavily on nostalgia. It was the "place to be" back in the day when Sydney’s late-night dining options were slim. But nostalgia doesn't justify the bill. The food and drinks are significantly overpriced for what you actually get on the plate. While the iced chocolate was nice and hit the spot, it doesn't make up for the fact that the overall food quality simply doesn't match the price point.
City Extra feels stuck in the past—except for its pricing, which is very much in the present. If you’re there for the memories or the 2 a.m. convenience, you’ll be fine. But if you’re looking for value for money or high-quality fare? Meh.

The food was really good. Portions were great and presentation was on point. The gentlemen who took our order was extremely kind. It isn't necessarily cheap, but considering the quality and location we were satisfied. Would definitely come back. Chicken Parm pictured below

Had brunch here in our recent holiday in Sydney. Serving sizes were huge. Happily offered gluten free option to our meals. Team were friendly and was so prompt to take our orders and deliver our meals. If ever back in Sydney would go there again for sure.

I visited recently after loving this place on a visit from overseas 9 years ago — it was just as good as I remembered! The server was prompt and very friendly, and our lattes were yummy. We both ordered fish and chips, which were delicious, served with a delicate breading, a tasty salad and wonderful thick chips/fries. Scones — our favorite from our visits years ago — made a scrumptious dessert, which were fabulous with clotted cream and jam. We got some for takeaway, and they were just as good for breakfast the next morning.

There are great seating options: inside at booths and tables, upstairs with views out over the harbor, and outdoors in front. All were popular.

Now I just have to make the 16-hour flight again before another 9 years!

reviews.review:
Had a Christmas lunch here with a friend. Was able to secure a last minute table at the front of the restaurant, it’s a lovely spot for catching Sydney latest fashion trends on the runway known as the Finger Wharf.

Cocktails came quickly, and delicious tasting. The same can be said for all the cuisine. The rainbow trout was a highlight as well as the yellowfin tuna cone.

Manta has had a glow up, definitely recommend checking it out

We went to Manta for both Christmas (drinks and oysters) and NYE (dinner) and, overall, it was excellent. There was a mix up with the reservation for NYE, we waited 45 mins between courses, a course arrived before our wine did. However these were the only negatives. The service was mostly excellent, the food was usually just as excellent, there is an excellent wine list and the location is quite amazing.

We had the classic tasting menu and can definitely recommend it! I think the price for value with 70 something $ is great for what you get. We loved all the dishes, and couldn’t even finish everything so you definitely get a lot. We especially liked the beef tataki and the spinach pasta

A wonderful dinner towards the end of winter where we couldn't fault anything. Had a very friendly European waiter who made the service even better with his banter.

Food was delicious, we enjoyed everything we ordered and left with hearts and bellies very full.

Will definitely be back to experience summer vibes.

Visited on a Saturday evening for the Seafood Indulgance
Warmly greeted and taken to our table with an amazing view of Sydney CBD skyline and the marina.
Our hostess was Linda, such a character. Friendly, attentive, and her banter made us feel as if we were the only guests in the restaurant.
Well done, Linda, your customer service skills are outstanding.
Our beverages were served quickly by the barman.
Our dishes came out 1 by 1 and were presented very well, very tasty and very large portions.
The food served was not 100% as per the menu offered when booking, but we did enjoy the meal and we savoured every mouthful.
Did not have any room for dessert, which is a first.
Had an absolute 1st rate visit to this well-known. Woolloomooloo venue

My partner makes the reservation with a glass of champagne upon arrival and we hope that the staff will bring it to the table without asking since it was specified in the booking that it was intended to be a surprise upon arrival.
We got a very complete set menu, fresh seafood, king fish, super recommended, the main was good except the steak which was well done and no one asked us how we wanted it to be cooked , we paid $22 extra to have oysters and truffle fries which is not bad but dessert was not the best to finish a seafood dinner, something more delicate should be better.
The bottle of wine was delicious, perfect food paring.

We had a perfect dinner in every respect. Lovely location, buzzy vibe, comfortable seating, attentive service and sensational food. Everything was super fresh, expertly prepared and enjoyable to eat. You rarely get all these characteristics together but Manta nails it.

I highly recommend Manta for any occasion.

Exceptional view, high-end food, and friendly staff. In particular, the manager had an old-school, personable manner, engaging in chat from the get-go and throughout the evening. Reminded me of what the restaurant scene in Sydney used to be like in the good ol’ days. Nothing was too difficult for this gentleman, even though we were a table of many different dietary requirements. The food was high quality and cooked with skill and simplicity. We brought our own cake - a fancy multi-tiered designer piece - and the restaurant did an exceptional job storing it safely, presenting it with candles and sparklers, and bringing it out at the perfect time. There are lots of restaurants at Wooloomooloo but I think this one is a standout.

reviews.review:
I had a wonderful dining experience at AALIA during my visit to Sydney. The restaurant offers beautifully executed Middle Eastern cuisine and you can really taste the authenticity and quality in every dish.

The food was excellent — rich in flavour, well balanced, and thoughtfully prepared. Each dish felt authentic while still being presented in a refined and modern way. It was a great introduction to Middle Eastern flavours done at a very high level.

The service was also superb. The staff were professional, attentive, and made the whole dining experience smooth and enjoyable from start to finish. You really feel well taken care of throughout the meal.

Overall, AALIA delivers both exceptional food and hospitality. If you’re looking for authentic Middle Eastern cuisine in Sydney with outstanding service, this is definitely a restaurant worth visiting.

Had such a beautiful dining experience at AALIA

We started with a 2015 Dom Pérignon Brut Champagne, and it truly set the tone for the night, elegant, smooth, and absolutely worth it 🥂

From the mezze, the Eggplant Mes ‘a’ah and the Smoked Buffalo Labneh were served separately, and both were exceptional in their own way. The eggplant was perfectly spiced and comforting, while the labneh was fresh, creamy, and beautifully balanced.

The Lamb Neck Shawarma was the standout, incredibly tender, melting in your mouth with rich, deep flavours. The Duck Fesenjan was good, but not as memorable as the rest.

For dessert, we followed the waiter’s recommendation and went with the mango & coconut dessert, and it was honestly the perfect finish. Light, refreshing, and exactly what you want after a rich meal. The dates with tea at the end were such a lovely touch and completed the whole Middle Eastern experience.

Overall, a refined and flavourful experience that I’d happily go back to.

Visited Aalia for our anniversary dinner and had such a wonderful experience from start to finish. We were welcomed with champagne on arrival, which was a really lovely touch, and the service throughout the night was exceptional.

We ordered a range of dishes from the à la carte menu and every item was extraordinary. The flavours complemented each other beautifully and each dish was presented so thoughtfully. It felt like a truly special dining experience and one we’ll definitely remember.

We visited Aalia to celebrate our anniversary and opted for the banquet for two. Unfortunately, the experience was deeply disappointing and fell well short of what one would expect from a two-hatted restaurant.

The food lacked flavour, care, and the staff and kitchen seemed overly relaxed and this carried through to the food that was served. Dishes were poorly presented and surprisingly bland, with little depth or cohesion. For the price point, the portion sizes were extremely small and represented very poor value for money. Nothing about the meal felt considered or memorable, which was especially disappointing for an anniversary dinner.

The service further detracted from the experience. The tables were sticky and the restaurant ambiance did not fit that of a two hatted restaurant. Adding to this, the restaurant does not have a toilet on the premises (and it was absolutely filthy), which is difficult to justify for a venue operating at this standard and price point.

For a restaurant holding two hats, the overall experience lacked polish and execution. The food was underwhelming, portion sizes small, the pricing unjustifiable, and the service inattentive. I don’t understand how this restaurant was awarded two hats.

This was not a dining experience we would return to or recommend.

I went here with my sister and my husband for mine and my sisters shared birthday.

My sister is vegetarian (for better or for worse, haha). But we were all hoping to do a set menu. Unfortunately, they did not have adequate substitutions in the set menus for vegetarians. When we went - in October - they did indeed have some substitutions but it felt rushed and not well thought out. So she was left out from the experience. There were options for her in the a la carte menu, however.

The staff were quite strange about all of this, and it took us talking to a few people to sort it out. The waitress serving us seemed a bit lost initially.

Other than that, the food was quite good - especially the meat. The quality is obviously there, though you do pay a premium price for it.

The ambience is lovely.

Overall, I would come again, but I am not in a major rush.

🧞‍♂️AALIA, one of the best and highly awarded restaurants in Sydney, and also listed as one of the 50 Best Restaurants in the World lived up to its accolades.

Innovative interpretations of North Africa & Middle Eastern cuisine, I was amazed by new flavours and experienced “first times” eg. first time eating raw 🐑 Lamb “Nayyeh” Tartare which was OMG so damn good.. the Eggplant was smoky and addictive, paired so well with their signature fluffy Pita.. Smoked Buffalo Labneh w/ Beetroot Molasses was another totally new unfamiliar yet highly enjoyable taste experience.. the Lamb Neck was super flavourful and melts in your mouth like it was bone marrow, while the Dry Aged Duck felt familiar yet unique like a “what if” they have Peking Roast Duck in North Africa… A must check-out dining experience if you’re ever in 🇦🇺Sydney! 😋

It was a fantastic experience from start to finish. Service and staff were super helpful, polite and nice to talk to. Shoutout to Nicos for providing optimal service and great recommendations. Food was probably the best food I have had for a while, maybe even ever. Would definitely come back soon!

I had an absolutely amazing experience at Aliaa. From the moment we walked in, everything was perfect. The manager was incredibly welcoming and professional, the service was attentive and friendly, and the atmosphere was beautiful and relaxing.

The food was outstanding. Everything tasted fresh and full of flavor. The oysters were WOW — some of the freshest and most delicious I’ve ever had. Every dish we ordered was prepared perfectly.

Honestly, 5 stars isn’t enough for this place — they deserve 10 stars. If you’re looking for amazing food, great service, and a wonderful atmosphere, Aliaa is a must visit. I can’t wait to come back!

reviews.review: Always have a fantastic lunch here. Have been here quite a few times and it’s always wonderful. Service is excellent and the food is fantastic. Great value for money, wonderful location, great staff. Shout out to Monique who was absolutely exceptional on Christmas Eve - we thank you very much for looking after us. We will definitely return as we always do, but for those contemplating a visit to your lovely restaurant - I would highly recommend this venue.. our family loves it. And yes, these dishes taste as good as they look!

We came here for a friend’s birthday and we were a group of 10. To our surprise, we weren’t made to die on a set menu. Having the option of A La Carte was quite lovely but for an indecisive group it would’ve been nice to have a set menu option as well

Service was really, really lovely. The waitresses and front of house was so kind and so accommodating Always. The only thing I would provide feedback on is the wait time on the food and service. Staff was super hospitable and really kind, but it did take a bit of time to get their attention.

Food also came on quite slow. I think it was also because we ordered after another big group and then there was other big groups around so took quite a while for us to get our food.
We had ordered a bottle of red to go with the mains and by the time we finished our glasses of wines the mains haven’t even arrived yet.

I love that they warm their bread, though with the oven that was quite a pleasant surprise
Otherwise, the food was overall quite pleasant, however nothing surprising. Everything we ate from the seafood platter to the lamb shoulder to the steaks, all the mains were like oh this is quite pleasant but none of it was like wow this is amazing

We also got two pastas they were cooked a bit past Al dente

Well, we have to commend the potatoes. The potatoes are amazing the creamy sauce and the fried speck was delicious.

For the entrées we had I think it was a salmon tartare or maybe a trout tartare - either way we knew that the starters had been left out for a bit because the the fish was practically room temperature fish - which wasn’t insanely pleasant. Same goes for the kingfish.

Overall, it was a fine meal

It’s food that isn’t particularly memorable, but it’s not food you would complain about

We held a 25th anniversary dinner in the private dining room. We had the most amazing night and everything just worked! The food was great and the service fantastic (particularly Ute). It was a 25th anniversary dinner to remember.

Beautiful location and view, great food and service.

Loved the oysters, which we tried both the WA and NSW coast ones. Mango soufflé was a standout dessert!

Public Dining Room, Balmoral was an absolute delight. The food was incredibly delicious, and we had a wonderful time bringing our parents along. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the view was simply stunning. A perfect spot for a special meal with family or friends — highly recommended!

Not sure how this restaurant can get anything below 5 stars! Everything was fabulous and Gina looked after us so, so well. We ate a lot but our recommendations would be - sourdough, soft shell crab, pork belly, rib eye and chocolate tart.
The only dish which missed the mark was probably the side of heirloom cauliflowers.
The food was lovely, especially the steak. The view was awesome.  The beach was right next to us. Highly recommended to visit in a sunny day.

Having dinning here on and off for over 15 years, food is always good, menu has change through the years and service is always been friendly.
It was a Tuesday night we dine here again and the restaurant is fairly quiet compare to the Monday's night we dine here last.
We order our favorite which we share between 3 of us. Food is really delicious, service is friendly, the only down sides is the main courses comes all together again which we specified we like to have them come separately.
Again it was a enjoyable evening. 8/10

reviews.review:
Really enjoyed the oysters, salmon sashimi, and chargrilled octopus. The apples in the salmon sashimi soaked up the sauce really well so every bite was packed with flavour. Octopus had the texture of meat and cooked well. I couldn't quite taste the crab in the special crab and prawn dumplings, so it was more like har gau. The crispy eggplant was also nice and saucey, it's a good dish to share for more than 2 people cos there were so many and got a bit too rich for me to have anymore. The salted lemonade mixer drink disappointedly just tasted like sprite so recommend getting a different drink.

Staff were super friendly and really on it. Food also came out promptly. Heating was also nice and distrbuted, not blasting in one area, so kept nice and warm as we ate outside on the cold night.

​If you are looking for a venue with an unbeatable atmosphere and stunning views, Lotus Barangaroo hits the mark perfectly. It’s an ideal spot for a memorable evening, bolstered by a team that provides truly friendly and attentive service. From the moment you walk in, the vibe is lively and sophisticated, making it a fantastic choice for a group dinner or a special night out.
​However, the experience did hit a slight snag regarding the kitchen’s timing. While the food was delicious when it arrived, the dishes were not coursed out effectively. Unfortunately, because the plates didn’t come to the table together, our first dish was stone cold by the time the final plate arrived, which slightly detracted from what would have otherwise been a flawless meal.
​Despite the timing hiccup, the combination of the scenery and the warm hospitality makes this a place I’d still recommend, especially if you’re looking to soak in the best of the waterfront. With a little more attention to synchronizing the service flow, this spot would be hard to beat.

A refreshing take on modern Chinese cuisine that balances tradition with a contemporary edge. The space is stylish and inviting, setting the tone for a relaxed yet refined dining experience.

The menu is thoughtfully curated, showcasing classic flavours presented in a modern way. Each dish is well-executed, with fresh ingredients, balanced seasoning, and beautiful presentation that elevates familiar favourites without losing their authenticity.

Service is attentive and professional, striking the right balance between warm and efficient. Dishes arrived promptly, allowing the meal to flow smoothly and making the experience feel effortless.

Overall, this restaurant delivers a confident and modern interpretation of Chinese dining elegant without being pretentious, flavour-forward without being heavy. A great choice for both casual catch-ups and special occasions, and a place worth returning to.

We booked a table for four at 5:30 pm on 29 May and had a wonderful experience.

A special thank you to the Asian young lady without glasses who served us and spoke a little Mandarin. She was so friendly, attentive, and helpful. Unfortunately, I forgot to ask for her name, but she made our evening truly special.

Great food, good service and nice vibe. We ordered only three dishes: Scallops, Steamed Baby Snapper and Wagyu Rice Noodles. All the dishes came out quickly and they are delicious.
Especially, I enjoyed the snapper. It is a good size for two and it is fresh. There are many restaurants along the walkway and hence competition is high. Lotus is one of the best.

Great experience & great flavours!  Service was knowledgeable, friendly and prompt.  Food was nicely presented, came quickly and was incredibly fresh and very flavoursome.  Price point was excellent, dishes were good size and excellent quality.
Genuinely impressed and highly recommend.

Seriously good Chinese food. This place gives China and Hong Kong a run more of its money. Dumplings are next level. Entrees , mains and desserts are also next level. Best choice to dine here by the water on New Years Eve. Then straight to the Crown Resort to watch the fireworks!

Just walked in (without a reservation) and was very fortunate to be early. It packed out here quickly and not surprising why - the food is so good.
My photos don’t do justice, had soft shell crab, dumplings, whole steamed fish and also the prawns.
All the meals were exceptional.
